system.name: PSR J1141-6545
system.source_label: Bhat, Bailes, Verbiest (2008) and Venkatraman Krishnan et al. (2020)

branches.label: scintillation_independent
branches.note: Independent scintillation inclination from the 2008 timing paper.

branches.label: timing_xdot_geometry
branches.note: Timing-derived inclination from the 2020 xdot analysis; retained only as a nuisance branch.

nuisance_notes: Aberration contributes < 21% of xdot_obs at 99% confidence, so >79% is attributed to WD-driven spin-orbit coupling.
The WD spin period is constrained to < 900 s at 99% confidence, or < 200 s with the prograde-rotation prior.

system.name: PSR J1906+0746

branches.label: dd_external_geometry
branches.note: DD-style timing summary with external inclination from Desvignes et al. (2019).

branches.label: ddgr_xdot_correlated
branches.note: DDGR+xdot timing summary; gamma uncertainty is widened because the paper reports xdot-gamma correlation.

nuisance_notes: The same paper states that fitting xdot shifts the individual masses by about 3.5 sigma because xdot and gamma are correlated.
The DDGR+xdot branch moves the pulsar mass to about 1.42 Msun, so J1906 may stop behaving like a clean low-side source once that covariance is carried through.
